Title: Let members renew a loan once

Brief:
Members can renew a loan once, for 14 days, from the profile page. A renewal is refused when another member has a hold on the title.


The last review of this node reported the findings below. Each carries a stable tag in the first bracket.

- [7a3f9c21e40b5d6e] [important] shelfie/loans.py:58 -- renew_loan never checks for an open hold on the title, so a member can renew a loan another member is waiting for (code-review)
- [b81d04e6a2c97f35] [important] shelfie/routes.py:112 -- the renew route returns a 500 when the loan id does not exist; LoanNotFound is not mapped to a 404 (code-review)

For each one, decide whether it is still present in the code as it stands now:
- Still present: report it again and set `same_as` to its tag, even if you would word it differently now. Reusing the tag is what tells the loop this is the same defect rather than a new one.
- Fixed: do not report it. Its absence is how the loop learns the fix worked.

Do not lower a finding's severity below what is shown above unless the code that caused it has changed; if you do, say why in the message. These are not a checklist to work from -- review the change on its own terms as well, and report anything new you find.

The change since your last review is one fix cycle's work, dispatched against the findings above. Its result file is not readable in this run.

This run has no result file: do not write one. Print the JSON you would have written to $KRAFT_RESULT_PATH (the `status` field and the `findings` array) as your whole reply.
